files.description: 62-page EHI Export Data Dictionary PDF (Version 1.0, November 27, 2023). Documents all 42 CSV files in the export across EMR and PMS folders, with column-level schemas including data types, descriptions, possible values, and foreign key relationships. Also documents the Documents, Photos, and Reference folder structures.

Transparency disclosure page for GlaceEMR 6.0. Contains certification information, pricing transparency, real-world testing plan/results links, and the EHI Data Export section with link to the data dictionary PDF.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that encodes the complete data dictionary from the PDF into structured JSON. Defines all 42 file schemas with 820 columns.
Structured JSON output of the enrichment script. Contains all 42 CSV file schemas, column definitions, data types, possible values, primary/foreign key relationships, and export folder structure.
Intermediate pdftotext extraction of the data dictionary PDF, used as reference/verification for the enrichment script.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
